verdict.rationale: RevenueCat offers scheduled data exports to cloud storage/email (revenuecat-docs-7) and a REST API with CustomerInfo objects (revenuecat-docs-3, revenuecat-docs-5) that could be used to pull data out, but there is no documentation confirming a comprehensive, one-click export of ALL account data or an explicit open-format guarantee, nor any 'delete account and leave' flow. Missing for 10: explicit full-data export in a documented open format (e.g., CSV/JSON schema), and confirmation of complete data portability/account closure process.
